notes.title: Version 1.0.0.6 (10/21/2017)
notes.content:
•	Added movement sound effects
•	Checkpoint system has been revised
•	Render order fixed in Grassy Sky
•	Adjusted Post Processing
•	Fixed problem in which the text of the elders showed up when the game is paused
•	Disable version and username when loading from the main menu
•	Fixed Tribulation and Jolute Checkpoints. These levels’ checkpoint broke with the 1.0.0.4 update
•	Renamed Crystal Core to Crystal Chamber for achievement clarity
•	Added additional visual effects

Here is hoping these changes didn't break anything else. :)

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.4 (9/18/2017)

notes.title: Release Day
notes.content: August 8th has finally arrived and our team is excited for the release of Squish and the Corrupted Crystal.  Thank you for playing our game and we look forward to your comments and suggestions in the discussion forum.
